description: Workers Issues observability.issues.enabled is documented at https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/issues/ (Wrangler 4.134.0+), including disabling Issues when omitted on redeploy. Add the missing boolean setting to script-settings GET/PATCH, combined settings GET/PATCH responses, and the script upload response. Alchemy WorkerIssues.test.ts live tests on 2026-10-05 verified PUT with issues-only observability (without top-level enabled), GET script-settings, combined GET settings, and PATCH false-to-true while preserving logs/traces. The same live repair test also verified minimal issues-only PATCH false-to-true without top-level enabled; make enabled optional on the PATCH request only, leaving response requirements unchanged.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Whether Workers Issues error monitoring is enabled.
